name: SARIMA (seasonal ARIMA)
when_to_use: Time series with a clear seasonal component (monthly/quarterly cycle) in addition to trend and autocorrelation; extension of the already cataloged ARIMA (12-arima) with seasonal terms (P,D,Q)m.
notes: Extension of the already cataloged ARIMA for when the pattern repeats in cycles (month, quarter). Applications: sales with year-end seasonality; energy consumption by season.

expected_input.question: How to forecast a time series whose pattern repeats in cycles?

plain_explanation.purpose: Forecasts series with strong periodic repetition (monthly, weekly) in addition to trend.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When the series has clear seasonality and you want a classical statistical model.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A column of values over time, regular, with several complete cycles.
plain_explanation.example: Forecast energy consumption month by month.
